correctness.rationale: For each integer b>=2 the Laplacian symmetry decomposition removes leaf-difference eigenvalue 1 and all branch-standard eigenvalues from root-child mutual support. Independently multiplied the symbolic 3x3 quotient spectral projectors: at 0,b,2b+1 the root-to-child entries are 1/[b(2b+1)], (b-1)/[b(b+1)], -2b/[(b+1)(2b+1)]. All are nonzero, sum to zero, and eigenvalues are integer with gcd 1; exact triangle-inequality alignment at t=odd pi iff b even. Summed moduli 4b/((b+1)(2b+1)), probability its square. Pairwise different non-star trees form an infinite family; finite b examples are not proof of infinity.
residual_risks: Only root-to-child pairs; fidelity decays as b^-2 and distance is one edge.
